context: The present thesis consisted of one RCT, one protocol article for a running RCT, and two register-based cohort studies. An abdominal binder had no analgesic effects or impact on seroma formation. We await early and late post-operative outcomes from a running RCT studying clinical effect of closing the hernia defect (inclusion is expected to end in October 2015).
target: The two cohort studies included in the present theses found that mesh repair halved the long-term risk of recurrence compared with sutured repair.
